events.title: Singapore Stock Market Expected To Remain Rangebound
events.description: The Singapore stock market has opened higher in two of three trading days since the end of the two-day losing streak in which it had dipped more than 10 points or 0.2 percent. The STI now sits just above the 5,420-point plateau although it's likely to open under water on Monday.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Spin Its Wheels On Monday
events.description: The Malaysia stock market has finished higher in four straight sessions, collecting almost 15 points or 0.9 percent in that span. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,610-point plateau although it may run out of steam on Monday.

events.title: Losing Streak May Continue For Japan Stock Market
events.description: The Japan stock market has moved lower in back-to-back sessions, sinking almost 950 points or 1.4 percent along the way. The Nikkei now sits just above the 62,690-point plateau and it may take further damage again on Friday.

events.title: South Korea Shares May Hand Back Friday's Gains
events.description: The South Korea stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last four trading days since the end of the two-day winning streak in which it had rallied more than 210 points or 3.6 percent. The KOSPI now sits just above the 5,550-point plateau although it may head south again on Monday.

events.title: Japan Leading Index Data Due On Monday
events.description: Japan will on Monday see August results for its leading and coincident indexes, highlighting a light day for Asia-Pacific economic activity. The leading index is expected to add 0.4 percent on month, slowing from 1.5 percent in July. The coincident is tipped to fall 1.9 percent after rising 1.7 percent in the previous month.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Advances As Concerns Of Rate Hike Due To Possible Higher Inflation Increase
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value edged higher on Friday as crude oil prices continued to surge for the second day supported by concerns of a potential U.S.-Iran war. Oil-driven inflation worries have led to expectations of an interest rate hike in the U.S.

events.title: Canadian Market Remains Weak Despite Coming Off Early Lows
events.description:
The Canadian stock market's benchmark S&P/TSX Composite Index remains firmly down in negative territory Friday afternoon despite regaining a significant portion of the ground it lost in early trades. 

Concerns about inflation and prospects of interest rate hikes amid elevated oil prices following the latest Houthi attacks on Saudi targets weigh on sentiment.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Moderately Lower
events.description: After edging up a bit at the start, the Swiss market retreated and stayed in negative territory throughout the session on Friday. Worries about inflation and possible monetary tightening by several global central banks rendered the mood cautious.

events.title: European Stocks Close Lower On Earnings, Weak Economic Data
events.description: The major European markets closed lower on Friday as largely weak regional PMI data, and concerns about inflation and monetary tightening amid continued rise in oil prices hurt sentiment. France's debt woes and uncertainty about returns on AI-related investments weighed as well.

events.title: U.S. Consumer Sentiment Deteriorates Far Less Than Previously Estimated In October
events.description: The University of Michigan released a report on Friday showing consumer sentiment in the U.S. deteriorated by far less than previously estimated in the month of October. The report said the University of Michigan's consumer sentiment index for October was upwardly revised to 48.0 from a preliminary reading of 46.3.

events.title: Bay Street Look Headed For Weak Start
events.description:
Canadian stocks are likely to open on a weak note on Friday amid concerns about inflation and prospects of interest rate hikes by the Canadian and U.S. central banks. Oil prices are up sharply, while precious metals are notably lower.

Canadian retail sales data, and quarterly earnings updates, as well as U.S. PMI reports are set to make a notable impact on price movements.

events.title: Eurozone Private Sector Growth At 4-Month Low
events.description: The euro area private sector softened to a four-month low in October as activity in France shifted back into contraction amid tightening financial conditions and rising political pressures, flash purchasing managers' survey data from S&P Global revealed Friday. The composite output index fell to 51.9 in October from 53.1 in the previous month, falling below the economist forecast of 52.7.

events.title: FTSE 100 Falls 0.5% On Weak Retail Sales, Consumer Confidence Data
events.description: The FTSE 100 declined 52.73 points to 10,672.32 Friday as weak retail sales, declining consumer confidence, and Middle East tensions offset private sector expansion. Retail sales fell 0.4% in September versus forecasts of 0.1%, while consumer sentiment hit its sharpest pandemic-era drop.
